name: smwmusic-touhou-shinpiroku-urban-legend-in-limbo-dichromatic-lotus-butterfly-red-and-white-star-mix
title: Touhou Shinpiroku ~ Urban Legend in Limbo - Dichromatic Lotus Butterfly ~ Red and White (Star-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Dichromatic Lotus Butterfly ~ Red and White from Touhou 14.5 Shinpiroku ~ Urban Legend in Limbo - Dichromatic Lotus Butterfly ~ Red and White. Decided to make this a more common thing like my other short mixes 'cuz it's fun to do so.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. E Minor w/ Slight Detune (Pseudo Paradise Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. E Minor (Urban Legend in Limbo Pitch)
ㅤ3. F# Minor (Seihou Pitch)
ㅤ4. G Minor (SC-88 Pitch)
ㅤ5. F Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. INTRO Enabled [turned on by default]
ㅤ2. INTRO Disabled
